title: RosterPerson
description:
A person’s properties and their values.

Device Assignment Services 5.0+

email_address.description: The email address of the person that Apple School Manager displays. Available in X-Protocol version 5 and later.

first_name.description: The person’s first (given) name. Maximum length iw 1024 UTF-8 characters. Available in protocol version 3 and later.

grade.description: The grade information for the student. Maximum length is 256 UTF-8 characters. Value can be null. Not used for instructors.

is_federated_auth.description: If `true`, the system enables federated authentication for the person from an external identity provider. Available in X-Protocol version 6 and later.

last_name.description: The person’s last name. Maximum length is 1024 UTF-8 characters. Available in protocol version 3 and later.

managed_apple_id.description: The Managed Apple Account for the person. Maximum length is 1024 UTF-8 characters.

middle_name.description: The person’s middle name. Maximum length is 1024 UTF-8 characters. Available in protocol version 3 and later.

name.description: The person’s name. Maximum length is 1024 UTF-8 characters.

op_date.description: The time stamp, in iSO 8601 format, when the system added, updated, or deleted the person.

passcode_type.description: The password policy of the person. Possible values are `complex`, `four`, or `six`. Available in protocol version 3 and later.

person_id.description: The `personid` of the person that Apple School Manager displays. Available in X-Protocol version 4 and later.

sis_username.description: The SIS `username` of the person that Apple School Manager displays. Available in X-Protocol version 5 and later.

source.description: The creation data source of the class.

source_system_identifier.description: The identifier that the organization configures for the person. Maximum length is 256 UTF-8 characters.

status.description: The status of the person. Possible values are `Active,` `InActive,` `FailedPasswordLocked`, and `AtoLocked`. `AtoLocked` indicates that the system detects account take over and temporarily locks the person until an authentic user claims it. Available in X-Protocol version 3 and later.

unique_identifier.description: The unique identifier for the person. Maximum length 256 UTF-8 characters.
